The '''''Loyal Defender''''' was a [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Warship/Legends|warship]] that took part in the [[Second Battle of Fondor]]. The vessel was so heavily damaged during the fight that an order to abandon ship was issued. The ''[[Compass Star]]'' was sent to keep the ship safe from attack as this was going on.
